source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Engine::execute/execute_inner -> input::seal -> input::interpret -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonTableGroupStatistics -> ports::json_table_group_statistics -> math::summarize per group -> JsonTableGroupStatisticsReport artifact -> Core dependencies and rendered output
supported_behavior: The Japanese header JSON表の「group」ごとに「value」の統計量を計算して: and strict quoted English json-table-group-statistics "group" "value": select two distinct named columns from a strict JSON string table.
Grouping uses exact decoded JSON string values in first-seen order; no case folding, trimming, Unicode normalization or numeric interpretation is applied to group keys.

Only the explicitly selected value column is interpreted. Each group must contain either unitless exact expressions or unit-bearing decimal literals; mixed interpretations within a group stop with a typed error.
Each group receives exact descriptive statistics. Mixed units convert only through the existing mm/cm/m/km length conversion; identical unit labels remain as supplied.
The report records the source digest, selected header indices and spans, row count, 0-based source row indices and original group/value cell byte spans with digests.
Input and serialized output are bounded at 256000 bytes; strict JSON string tables are bounded at 4096 data rows, 256 columns and 65536 cells.
known_limits: No test or ordinary CLI route was executed for this slice.

Only a strict JSON object containing exactly columns and rows, with a unique named header, string cells and two distinct named columns is supported; empty tables, missing columns and invalid or mixed measured values suspend.
The operation describes supplied rows and does not infer population representativeness or general table schemas.
